offence_note: Aggravated assault with knife; breach of probation
sentence_quote: in addition to the three year sentence on Count No. 3, I also sentence you to a sentence of 30 days on Count No. 6 and, of course, this latter sentence is to be served concurrently
note: Joint recommendation accepted; 30 days concurrent on breach; victim surcharge waived.

offence_note: Breach of probation by possessing tools
sentence_quote: This is a sentence appeal from a suspended sentence, with further probation for 18 months, imposed after Mr. Baghaii pleaded guilty to breaching a probation order by possessing tools
note: Appeal for conditional discharge instead of suspended sentence dismissed.

offence_note: Violent rape at knifepoint; dangerous offender designation
sentence_quote: The appellant appeals from the finding by Wren J. in 2001 that the appellant is a dangerous offender and from the sentence of indeterminate detention.
note: Appeal sought determinate sentence plus long-term supervision; dismissed.

sentence_quote: In my opinion the case should be remitted to the Court of Appeal to pass sentence, after the appellants have been given the opportunity to make submissions to that Court on that matter.
note: Appeals dismissed on merits; sentence of six months remitted for new sentencing; number of appellants assumed two.

offence_note: Sexual interference of 13-year-old; breach of probation
sentence_quote: I agree with my colleague that the four-year sentence imposed on Mr. Scott is not unfit.
note: Majority reasons not shown; concurring judge agrees four-year sentence fit; four years plus four months consecutive.

offence_note: Three counts counselling murder; possessing firearms while prohibited
sentence_quote: This results in a global sentence of 18 years imprisonment.
note: Other order: reasons forwarded to CSC under s. 743.2; victim surcharge declined.

offence_note: Producing MDMA, possession for trafficking, possessing production substances
sentence_quote: I sentence Mr. Alves to three years' imprisonment on counts 1 and 2, and two years' imprisonment on Count 3. All sentences are to be served concurrently with each other.
note: Joint submission accepted; judge recommends work release and Lower Mainland placement.

offence_note: Making and possessing child pornography; invitation to sexual touching of child
sentence_quote: the sentences on the three charges will aggregate a global total of two years less a day of incarceration to be followed by a probation order of three years
note: Crown appeal allowed; trial sentence was one year concurrent plus three years probation.

offence_note: Two counts trafficking in cocaine, 3 kg total
sentence_quote: He was sentenced to 8 years in custody less credit of one year and 5 months for pre-trial custody and credit for strict bail conditions.
note: Effective sentence 6 years 4 months after credits and a third transaction; leave granted, appeal dismissed.
